_schema: preservation-loan-book scoring shared adjustments v1.0. Applied by scripts/score_preservation.py (plb/scoring.py) after per-class factor points are computed from the class JSON (affordable_public_am.json; noah_watch.json when --noah-watch). Class files never restate anything in this file. Ported from off-market-deal-finder v2 with every buyer-side rule removed: no deal-size or mission-fit multipliers, no housing-authority cap, no acquisition routing, no penalties block (recent_rehab lives only in the physical factor).
governing_event_rule: points = (base-band take + modifiers, capped at the weight) x basis_multiplier x post_multipliers. For each event-driven factor the basis multiplier is the minimum across the BASE bands that scored (for basis_from governing_event, the governing owner-cliff event); modifiers keep their own event basis and never move the factor multiplier. An event's confidence (< 1) scales the points of every band or modifier that event matched (HAP_EXPIRATION 0.70 annual / term unknown; 0.90 20-year MAHRA or agency PBV contract). A Verify — Ambiguous flag on a base event forces 0.40. Worked example: Powell Plaza I clock = (18 x 0.70 + 2 x 0.70 + 3) x 0.90 = 15.3 of 20.

urgency_bands.note: for an AGENCY_DEADLINE the act-by date passed; for an owner cliff the date passed with no renewal or termination evidence (verify case; STALE_CONTRACT_DATE rows are reported separately)
outside the 10-year horizon; never scored; counted in Board_Totals 'beyond horizon'

urgency_scale_note: Bands are months, not critical-dates-tracker's days. board_impact = units_at_risk x timing_fraction(owner_cliff_band). action_band = min(agency act-by, owner cliff) drives the queue sort; Board_Totals and Units_by_Year band on owner_cliff_band.

queue_bands.requires: any dated PRESSURE event inside horizon
no dated PRESSURE event inside horizon, In Development, outside geography, or under 5 units with no program event (exclusion_reason names the cause)

recap_status.description: Applied to factors restriction_hap_qc_clock and declared_intent_vs_silence only (class files list it under post_multipliers). A property already being recapitalized by a mission sponsor stays in the universe and is labeled, never excluded or zeroed.
recap_status.evidence_rule: 0.5 applies only when recap_evidence_basis is RECORDED or REPORTED (forecast status Preserved / Resyndicated / Extended, the agency's own application pipeline, or a recorded closing); hearsay keeps 1.0 and adds signal recap_status_unverified.

mandate_eligibility.description: Route-level filter on nofa_offer. A product qualifies when status in {open, rolling} AND (eligible_programs empty or intersects programs_list) AND owner_type not in ineligible_owner_types AND (eligible_owner_types empty or owner_type in it) AND units >= min_units (units, not units_at_risk) AND (application_window absent or as_of inside it). mandate_fit = eligible if any product qualifies; ineligible if products exist and none qualifies (mandate_ineligible_reason = first failing test per product, ';'-joined); no_mandate_file when the pack has no mandate.json (signal mandate_unknown; nofa_offer still allowed).
mandate_eligibility.effect_on_ineligible: nofa_offer blocked; mandate_fit and mandate_ineligible_reason written as lead columns; lead still scores and routes elsewhere; never an exclusion reason; no multiplier anywhere

suppressions.effect: all DEBT-family factors score 0 (our_capital_at_risk DEBT bands included; REGULATORY bands unchanged); REGULATORY, OWNERSHIP, TAX_LIEN, PHYSICAL, OPERATING, AGENCY_DEADLINE factors unchanged
queue_band EXCLUDED; exclusion_reason in_development; listed under 'Pipeline, not scored'

caps.condition: every governing event has basis PROXY
caps.label: cap:proxy-only

caps.condition: no dated PRESSURE event inside horizon

decay.description: Events older than 180 days count at 50% in stacking factors, except permanent states and open conditions.
decay.note: A COVENANT_DEFAULT 400 days old still scores 15 while covenant_status remains default; it closes when covenant_status moves to cured or released (kpi covenant_cured).

stacking_rules.independence: Families count once each. Helper deadlines (AGENCY_DEADLINE family, PRESERVATION_NOTICE_WINDOW) and NOTICE_COMPLIANCE_BREACH never count toward programs_ending_same_24mo. Agency servicing rows, HUD tapes, OHCS inventory and SOS records are independent legs; OHCS and the OHCS forecast are the same upstream.

routes.rules_location: affordable_public_am.json routes.rules (statutory clocks first, then money, then programs); each rule is gated by the agency profile's routes_enabled (references/sources/<pack>/agency-profiles.yaml) and self_owned rows skip notice_compliance, designee_rofr, nofa_offer, ta_sponsor

evidence_rule.description: Every factor stores evidence[] (event ids with date, basis, source, or signal and value), reading (one line: how the agency asset manager experiences it) and intervention (the tool the agency can deploy, by catalog id). A factor with empty evidence scores 0 regardless of band match. A factor whose `requires` fails scores 0 with the factor_status named in on_requires_fail (WATCH for a missing expected book join).

removed_from_v2: routing_rules.watch (WATCH is a queue band, not a route)
